_comment: Agent images the platform ships (TODO 244e5de5), shown under the menu entry Container.
dockerfileSha256 is the sha256 of ai-automation-backend/<dockerfile>; scripts/build-agent-images.sh writes
the same value into the image label org.mysuricates.dockerfile-sha256, and the overview reports an image
whose label differs as outdated. AgentImageCatalogGateTest keeps this file equal to the Dockerfiles:
after changing a Dockerfile, put its new sha256 here (the test prints it) and adjust tools if needed.
source: release = downloaded binary pinned by the ARG named in arg, base = comes with the base image,
